newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutricia shares rise after trading halt.
newsitem.headline: Nutricia shares rise after trading halt.

text.p: Shares in food group Nutricia NV rose when they resumed trading after being suspended by the Dutch bourse earlier on Friday.
The shares were suspended at 260.50 guilders, 16.20 guilders below Thursday's close. By 1232 GMT the shares had rallied to be 9.70 guilders lower at 267.00.

Earlier the company said it had withdrawn its Milumil baby milk powder from the British market as a precautionary measure after speculation it could be linked to a risk of salmonella poisoning. It said there was no proof of a link.
